commit_attribution: Primary human-authorized operator session; no delegated worker was used and no delegated worker finalized, committed, or pushed. DELEGATED .3 FINALIZATION / COMMIT / PUSH: UNAUTHORIZED preserved.
summary: Repaired a genuine PCAE notification-lifecycle observability defect exposed by a read-only audit of the completed configured-agent-identity IV's Telegram dispatch: TelegramSink.send() already received Telegram's real Bot API JSON responses (ok, and on success a result Message object carrying message_id) for both the summary and document operations, but collapsed each into an in-process boolean and discarded the rest -- once the process exits, nothing durable on disk could answer whether Telegram actually accepted either send. .last-notified.json was confirmed to be a dedup marker only, and the separate .pcae/delivery-receipts/ External Delivery Receipt Model (Phase 134E.7) was confirmed to be explicitly documented as not-yet-active lifecycle authority, with only synthetic (recording_v1/null_v1) registered adapters -- wiring a real Telegram adapter into that dormant architecture is explicitly reserved for a separate, not-yet-implemented 134E.10 Final Lifecycle Integration phase, so this repair instead adds the smallest new, purpose-built receipt persistence directly in TelegramSink. Every real Telegram operation now gets a durable PREPARED receipt before the network call and a final classified receipt afterward (API_ACCEPTED / API_REJECTED / TRANSPORT_FAILED / OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN), atomically written, excluding the bot token/raw URL/chat profile data, with Telegram's message_id captured when returned. report.notification_result["success"]'s existing boolean contract is byte-unchanged; a new additive telegram_receipts key attaches the receipt references. No re-dispatch of the affected historical IV report was performed; its original Telegram acceptance is honestly represented as NOT INDEPENDENTLY AUDITABLE from durable PCAE evidence. VERDICT: DURABLE TELEGRAM ACCEPTANCE RECEIPT / PHASE-NOTIFICATION AUDITABILITY REPAIR IMPLEMENTED -- FRESH INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION REQUIRED. The separate post-completion full-repository sweep (40587 passed / 979 failed / 117 errors) remains frozen, separate evidence, not classified or repaired here. F-5 continuation execution remains HOLD pending that separate triage. N-16-5 remains NOT CLOSED.
derived_correctness: Independently exercised (fresh 41-case suite, deterministic local HTTP seams via TelegramSink's disclosed _opener test seam, no real network calls, no live bot token required): ok:true with a valid integer message_id classifies API_ACCEPTED and persists the message_id; ok:true without one classifies OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN, never blindly accepted; ok:false via a real HTTPError (matching actual Telegram rejection behavior) classifies API_REJECTED with a sanitized error; a raised URLError/transport exception classifies TRANSPORT_FAILED; summary-accepted/document-rejected is represented as two independent receipts, never collapsed into a false all-success message; a forced receipt-persistence failure (blocked target subdirectory) returns (False, error) without raising and without silently masking the failure, and a best-effort PERSISTENCE-FAILURES.log fallback (written directly under the still-writable receipts root) captures it; exactly one network call per operation (no retry loop, no duplicate-send risk).
